steps.content: The dim room is so quiet that breaths of the only person inside are audible. The only light source is her phone screen with its brightness set to the lowest.

The girl looks extremely young, but she has already mastered the technique of touching the screen with only her fingertips, making no tapping sound with her nails at all, as if she's a well-trained secret agent.
She is like a quiet, inconspicuous mushroom growing in a dark corner. An otherwise cramped environment makes her feel safe and at ease.

<color=#fb9259>DoomSwamp:</color> Has this happened to anyone else? I was just checking a DM on a forum, and the moment I opened it I was gone! One second and I ended up in a place I'd never seen before!
<color=#fb9259>DoomSwamp:</color> What's happening? Is this some new type of scam? Or has my crazy classmate finally decided to abduct me?

<color=#fb9259>DoomSwamp:</color> I thought since I'm here, I might as well think of it as a free vacation. But the other people in the group are all so weird. It's like they're on some kind of drug. They're all acting a bit crazy and frankly just despicable.
<color=#fb9259>DoomSwamp:</color> They keep shoving things they think I'd like at me. It's so annoying! Who'd like those fluffy things anyway!
<color=#fb9259>DoomSwamp:</color> We were all taken to this place against our will anyway, why do they keep lecturing me like they think they're better than me? GET LOST!

On the gray forum page, glowing characters stream down like a waterfall. One after another, approving replies refresh at the bottom of the screen, and the red notification for likes flashes frequently.
Shrooma seems encouraged, typing more and more excitedly. Her fingers tapping away turn into a blur above the black smartphone, the emotions in her text almost dripping off the screen.
But just as everything appears to be going well, someone pushes open the window from the outside, interrupting this revelry in the two-dimensional world.

steps.speaker: Unknown Guest A
steps.content: Whoa, look, they even allow little kids like this on Elysiland.

steps.speaker: Unknown Guest A
steps.content: No way, are you doing your homework on Elysiland? Hey, kiddo, put that away! Come out and play!

steps.speaker: Unknown Guest B
steps.content: Hahaha! Exactly, forget all about your homework or studies here. Can't you see we're right next to the real sea here? Don't you want to play?

With her back turned to them, Shrooma rolls her eyes at the two, but when she turns around, she has already put on an innocent and adorable look, responding to the adults' "kind advice" softly with her head bowed.

steps.speaker: Shrooma
steps.content: Mom and Dad say no matter where I am, I must stick to my routine: homework, lesson preparation, and memorizing stuff I've learned. Once I finish, I can go play. Thank you for inviting me!

The sea breeze lifts the curtain covering the window. The light pouring in reveals the room's dreamy true appearance. Colorful veils, cute plush toys, and expensive anime and game merch. Not to mention the bright, attractive beach facilities outside the window. But Shrooma remains completely unmoved.
The disappointed guests leave without noticing that Shrooma is still typing her post rapidly in the dark corner.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: I thought a kid her age loved these kinds of things? But she doesn't seem interested at all... Hmm, intriguing.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Hmm? A new post on the forum at this hour?

<color=#fb9259>DoomSwamp:</color> Argh, here we go again. Another busybody! Why do you care if I've eaten or if I'm gonna go out? I'm not some naive kid who'll believe that this place can grant all your wishes just because you tell me so!
<color=#fb9259>DoomSwamp:</color> This isn't some weird education camp my helicopter relatives have signed me up for, is this?! I'm seriously at my wit's end!
The loading bar fills up and the post is successfully sent. Shrooma stares at the updated post and sighs.

steps.speaker: Shrooma
steps.content: Sigh, the internet speed here is pretty good though. But it's almost been an hour, it's almost time for my internet curfew... I really don't want to go offline yet...

steps.speaker: Shrooma
steps.content: It's almost meal time too. It's probably going to be those healthy veggies they think are good for me. Just thinking about it kills my appetite...

steps.speaker: Shrooma
steps.content: ...Huh? How do I still have access to the internet? Is something wrong with the parental control software...?
She tests it by liking a forum post she's been following. The number updates immediately, and the homepage content continues to refresh smoothly.
The girl seems to realize something and dashes to the pink microwave used for ordering food. Sure enough, there she finds a kid's meal overloaded with sugar and fat.

steps.speaker: Shrooma
steps.content: There's nothing I don't want! What's going on? Have I been bugged?

steps.speaker: Shrooma
steps.content: Or is this place really just as that suspicious tagline says... A place where <color=#fb9259>all wishes come true</color>?

steps.speaker: Shrooma
steps.content: Then would it be okay if I asked for... hmm, a soft doll that won't hurt when I punch it?

steps.speaker: Gentle Voice
steps.content: Of course! You don't need to hold back here on Elysiland. Everything you want, we have it!

steps.speaker: Gentle Voice
steps.content: And you can rest assured! The only rule here is joy. You don't have to worry about anyone criticizing you. Everything here happens only to meet your expectations!

With that unknown voice, the revolving wardrobe spins open, from which a giant doll falls out. Shrooma grips her black smartphone and cautiously takes two steps back, only to find that the voice is coming from a small speaker.

steps.speaker: Shrooma
steps.content: Who are you? Are you the owner of this place? Can-can you hear me?

steps.speaker: Shrooma
steps.content: So I guess no one's monitoring me... I just hope in the end no one's gonna jump out and announce that I've lost all my credits or something...
Though her tone still remains cautious, having had her wishes granted a few times already, Shrooma visibly relaxes her guard.

She takes one last look around to confirm no one is watching her, and that the internet is still connected. She picks up her phone, sits on the bed, curls up like a little mushroom, and starts typing away.
